about.title: Experienced website design and development built on 6+ years of results
paragraphs: I’m Ese Victor, a web designer and developer with over six years of experience creating fast, beautiful, and easy-to-use websites for businesses in Santa Catarina.

From a simple landing page to a professional business website or online store, I create sites that help companies in Florianópolis, São José, Joinville, and Balneário Camboriú attract more clients and close more sales.
My focus is clean design, local SEO, and fast performance so your website looks great, loads quickly, and converts visitors into customers.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.description: Clear answers to the most common questions about website design, timelines, support, SEO (Visibility), domain setup, hosting, and everything you need to know before starting your project.

items.question: Is hosting included in the price?
items.answer: No. Hosting is charged separately because each project may need different resources. We still guide you toward the best option, help with setup, and offer special conditions for clients who build their website with us.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. After the website goes live, we can handle updates, small adjustments, fixes, monitoring, and ongoing improvements. This keeps your website secure, fast, and aligned with your business as it grows.

items.question: Do you build custom websites or use templates?
items.answer: We build custom websites based on your business goals, identity, and audience. We can use visual references to speed up decisions, but the layout, content, and structure are planned for your brand.

items.question: Will my website appear on Google?
items.answer: Yes. We build with SEO (Visibility) best practices, including organized structure, titles, descriptions, performance, and search-focused content. Results also depend on competition and ongoing strategy, but your website starts prepared to be found.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: On average, 5 days to 4 weeks depending on the number of pages, content, revisions, and required integrations. Smaller projects can be delivered faster, while online stores or websites with specific features may take longer.

items.question: Will the site be mobile optimized?
items.answer: Yes. Every project is responsive and designed to work well on phones, tablets, and desktops. We also pay attention to buttons, forms, readability, and loading speed so visitors can contact you easily.

items.question: What information do I need to provide to create my website?
items.answer: We need information about your company, goals, target audience, design preferences, and the content you want to include on your website.

items.question: Do you offer SEO (Visibility) services to improve my website's ranking?
items.answer: Yes. We apply on-page SEO (Visibility) techniques such as keyword optimization, meta tags, URL structure, and website performance to improve visibility in search engines.

items.question: Do you create all types of websites?
items.answer: We develop most types of websites, including business websites, online stores, portfolios, blogs, landing pages, and more. However, we do not create websites that promote pornography, illegal drugs, deceptive religious practices, hate speech, scams, or any illegal or harmful activities. Our goal is to develop professional, ethical digital solutions aligned with values that generate positive impact for businesses and society.

items.question: What additional services can you offer?
items.answer: We offer services such as content creation, digital marketing, social media integration, logo creation, letterhead, digital business cards, app development, and online strategy consulting. These services can be contracted along with website development or as complements to strengthen your digital presence and achieve better results.

items.question: Can I see previous projects?
items.answer: Of course! Visit our Portfolio section to check out some of our previous work. We have a variety of projects that demonstrate our experience in creating custom, responsive, and optimized websites for different sectors and needs. If you'd like to see more examples or are interested in a specific type of project, contact us so we can share more details.

items.question: What types of websites do you develop?
items.answer: We develop most types of websites, including business websites, online stores, portfolios, blogs, landing pages, and more.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept Pix, credit cards, bank slips, and electronic transfers. We can also split card payments into an agreed number of interest-free installments, depending on the project value and the conditions defined in the proposal.

items.question: Can I edit the content later?
items.answer: Yes. We provide access to an intuitive admin panel where you can easily and quickly update texts, images, and other content on your website.

items.question: Which industries do you create websites for?
items.answer: We create custom websites for a wide variety of industries, including e-commerce, education, healthcare, technology, professional services, entertainment, and more. Our goal is to develop digital solutions that meet the specific needs of each industry and help our clients achieve their business goals.

items.question: What are the development timelines?
items.answer: The timeline for website development can vary depending on project complexity, number of pages, features, and necessary integrations. On average, the process takes 5 days to 4 weeks, but simpler projects can be completed faster, while more complex projects may take a bit longer. During the briefing phase, we will discuss the project scope and provide a more accurate timeline estimate based on your specific needs.

items.question: Can you help with domain and professional email setup?
items.answer: Yes. We can guide domain registration, DNS setup, hosting connection, and professional email configuration. If you already have a domain, we review the current access and connect everything carefully.

items.question: Do I need to have text and images ready before starting?
items.answer: Not necessarily. If you already have photos, a logo, and text, we use them as a starting point. If you do not, we can help organize your information, suggest the content structure, and create clearer copy to present your services.

items.question: Do you build online stores with online payments?
items.answer: Yes. We build online stores with product catalogs, carts, checkout, and payment integrations when the project requires it. During briefing, we define products, shipping, payment methods, legal pages, and the best purchase flow for your customers.

items.question: What happens after I approve the quote?
items.answer: After approval, we confirm the scope, collect materials, define the page structure, and begin the design. You follow the steps, send feedback, and approve the website before launch so it reflects your brand and goals.

items.question: How many revisions can I request?
items.answer: The number of revisions depends on the approved package and scope. We usually include adjustment rounds to review copy, images, sections, and visual details before launch, making sure the final result matches what was agreed.

items.question: Can the price change during the project?
items.answer: The approved price stays the same for the agreed scope. It only changes if you request new pages, extra features, additional integrations, or major changes outside the original plan. If that happens, we let you know first and send a new quote for approval.

items.question: Will I own the website after it is finished?
items.answer: Yes. After delivery and the agreed payment, the website belongs to the client. We also guide you through important access details, domain, hosting, and administration so you have control over your digital presence.

items.question: Can you integrate the website with WhatsApp, social media, and external tools?
items.answer: Yes. We can integrate WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Google Maps, forms, analytics tools, ad pixels, and other platforms depending on the project needs. These integrations help turn visitors into leads and customers.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: The first step is to contact us through WhatsApp or the form. We will understand your business, goals, website type, timeline, and budget. Then we send a clear proposal with scope, steps, and next actions.

items.question: Do I need to pay everything before the project starts?
items.answer: Not necessarily. The payment structure is defined in the proposal. In many cases, we work with an initial deposit to start the project and the remaining amount divided by milestones or paid near launch.

items.question: Do you hold meetings during the project?
items.answer: Yes. We can align through WhatsApp, video calls, or messages, depending on what is most practical for you. The goal is to answer questions, confirm important decisions, and keep the project moving clearly.

items.question: Will my website have an SSL security certificate?
items.answer: Yes. We configure the website to use HTTPS/SSL when the hosting provider supports it. This helps protect browsing, improves visitor trust, and supports SEO (Visibility) best practices.

items.question: Can you improve a website I already have?
items.answer: Yes. We can review your current website and suggest improvements for design, speed, content, SEO (Visibility), responsiveness, and conversion. Depending on the project condition, we can improve the existing site or recommend a new version.

items.question: Can I hire you for only a landing page?
items.answer: Yes. A landing page is a good option when you need to promote a specific service, campaign, product, or offer. It can focus on WhatsApp, forms, lead capture, paid traffic, or local conversion.
